title: Hub-First Causal-Neighborhood Association Protocol
objective: Increase opportunity recall and reduce hub-detection-to-underwriting lag by expanding each broad-hub event into a bounded causal neighborhood before waiting for later media narratives to name the beneficiaries.
discoveryEntryUnchanged: Broad professional/generalist hubs remain the only primary discovery entry. This protocol does not scan sectors, tickers or primitive categories independently.

postHubAssociation.trigger: A broad hub item describes a material economic state change, surprise, acceleration, disruption, policy shift or business-model change.
postHubAssociation.rule: Generate hypotheses in these directions from the specific hub event, then query specialist/primary evidence only to verify or kill those hypotheses. The directions are reasoning prompts, not independent discovery feeds.
stopConditions: no listed expression with verifiable exposure
association requires more than three unsupported causal jumps
all candidate expressions are already highly absorbed without a fresh incremental driver

earliestEvidenceClosedCheckpoint.principle: The decision clock starts when the broad hub first exposes the abnormality. Do not wait for a later generalist article to summarize the full investment thesis if specialist and company evidence can close the chain earlier.
earliestEvidenceClosedCheckpoint.weeklyFreeze: Freeze at the first weekly checkpoint when all required layers are sufficiently resolved under unchanged V1.9 rules.

unchangedUnderwriting: No relaxation of direct exposure, earnings conversion, expectation, valuation, timing, quality or adversarial gates.
A causal association is not a selection.
A company can be economically connected but rejected because the market has already absorbed the change.
antiOverfit: Do not hard-code shipping, containers, vaccines, property, pharma or any industry.
Do not search named later winners.
Do not add a causal direction merely because a revealed winner belonged to it.
Do not validate this candidate protocol on the same 2020 examples that motivated it; freeze and test unchanged on another year.
